evals.prompt: Search Google Shopping Light for wireless earbuds with gl=US and hl=en, then summarize the top products instead of dumping raw JSON.
evals.expected_output: Uses the google-shopping-light-search script with q, gl, and hl; summarizes product titles, prices, ratings, merchants, and links when available.

evals.prompt: 查一下 Google Shopping Light 上的 running shoes，第 20 个结果开始，device=mobile，并保存原始 JSON。
evals.expected_output: Uses q=running shoes, start=20, device=mobile, and an output path; preserves the raw JSON. Does not pass sort_by because the Light endpoint does not support it.

evals.prompt: Search Google Shopping Light for espresso machine on google.com with country US and language English. Use desktop results.
evals.expected_output: Uses q=espresso machine, google_domain=google.com, gl=US, hl=en, and device=desktop without inventing unspecified fields.
